name: STEVE-21K
description: STEVE-21K is a dataset collected to evaluate an embodied agent in the Minecraft virtual environment, including vision-environment pairs, knowledge question-answering pairs, and skill-code pairs to assess tasks like block search, knowledge QA, and tech tree mastery.
reputation: A newer Minecraft embodied-agent dataset that is useful for evaluating multimodal agents, but it is not yet a broadly established community benchmark.
notes: Dataset includes 600+ vision-environment pairs, 20K QA pairs, and 200+ skill-code pairs for embodied agent evaluation in Minecraft.
